song: dīkṣādikaśca saṃskāraḥ svātmano yatra cāhni tat bhavejjanmadinaṃ mukhyaṃ jñānasantānajanmataḥ

rows.grounds: Gloss 'and-initiation-and-so-on'; dīkṣā + ādi compound (dvandva/itaretara or bahuvrīhi context) + ca indeclinable conjunction.
Gloss 'consecration'; saṃskāraḥ = m. nom. sg. of saṃskāra.
Gloss 'of-one's-own-self'; svātmano = gen. sg. of svātman (reflexive possessive compound svā + ātman).
Gloss 'and-day'; cāhni = ca (indecl., conjunction) + ahan (n. loc. sg. 'ahni', sandhi cā + ahni).
Gloss 'that'; tat = n. nom. sg. of pronoun tad.

Gloss 'would-be-birth-day'; bhavet + janmadinam: janmadinaṃ = n. nom./acc. sg. of janmadina (janman + dina compound); bhavej = 3sg.opt.act. of √bhū (AMBIGUOUS: optative 'would-be' inferred from context).
Gloss 'primary'; mukhyaṃ = n. nom./acc. sg. of mukhya, agreeing with janmadinaṃ (contextually neuter).

Gloss 'from-birth-of-knowledge-lineage'; jñānasantānajanmataḥ = abl. sg. of a bahuvrīhi/tatpuruṣa compound jñāna-santāna-janman (jñāna + santāna + janman); ablative case marked by -taḥ. AMBIGUOUS: exact compound membership not fully determinable from form alone.
